record.title: Saint-Martin Sint Maarten second 2020 nonessential crossing ban
record.direction: Primarily entry from Sint Maarten to French Saint-Martin; physical barriers at selected roads affected passage.
record.exceptions: Verified work/medical journeys and specified arriving air passengers.
record.enforcement: Policy or report as cited; uniform implementation at every crossing not presumed.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Slow COVID transmission and protect hospital capacity.
record.uncertainty: More than routine border checks: nonessential crossing prohibited and two roads physically blocked. Endpoint removes main checks; containers removed later; no assumption all crossings open same hour.
